scope: Only two exact files read; no base64 display, product execution, failure replay or current-role mutation.

confirmed_schema.original: Exact historical logical pin {path,bytes,sha256}; logical identity is row['original']['path'].
confirmed_schema.archive: Exact physical before pin {path,bytes,sha256}; physical file location is row['archive']['path'].
confirmed_schema.base64: Full before-byte string remains in original invocation; not printed or reconstructed by this disposition.
confirmed_schema.identity_rule: Compare pin identities using path/bytes/sha256 only, preserve all other generation metadata. Historical original identity does not assert the current logical role file still equals its old bytes; resolve that generation through its archive/full before.
